meta.hypothesis: IRT chemistry G-values at 1 us are non-monotonic in primary energy (the LET-driven V-shape, cf E10b/E10d), and the full 8-energy ESTAR sweep can be produced on free GitHub Actions infra (16 GB runner, no WebGPU) from the committed rad_buf dumps.
meta.method: tools/run_irt.cjs replayed each rad_E<E>_N4096.bin dump on a separate runner (dynamic matrix, fail-fast:false), GPU-free. Dumps on validation-inputs-v1 release. Post-joint-fix shaders (sigma_exc=0.5, RECOMB_BOOST=2.0).
meta.infra: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest (15 GiB, 4 cores), chemistry-validation.yml run 26995662317, 8 energies in parallel
meta.note: First validation artifact computed entirely on free CI infra rather than the local machine — see FREE_COMPUTE.md.

summary.headline: 8-energy IRT sweep on free CI: G(OH) V-shape min at 1000 eV (0.9601), G(eaq) min at 3000 eV (1.0322) — LET-driven non-monotonicity (cf E10b 126 sigma). OH endpoints 2.52 (100 eV) / 1.77 (20 keV).
